svg.title: 故事解决与形式终止 / Story resolution and formal finality
svg.desc: Two-dimensional teaching matrix inspired by the Raskin/Neupert distinction. Story resolution and explicit formal termination need not coincide. The 400 Blows is one source-grounded comparison, not quantitative data.
